claims.subject: odysseus.hermes-proxy.routing
claims.claim: src/hermes_proxy.py forwards a request to the Hermes backend only when its Host is exactly hermes.localhost:<listener port>; every other request goes to Odysseus untouched.

evidence.contains: Host is exactly hermes.localhost:<listener port> are forwarded to the Hermes backend

claims.subject: odysseus.webapp-component.ownership
claims.claim: src/hermes_webapp_component.py starts, stops and restarts only a managed Webapp gateway; a gateway adopted from the user is user-owned and Odysseus refuses to start, stop or restart it.

evidence.contains: This gateway is user-owned (adopted); Odysseus never starts, stops or restarts it.

claims.subject: odysseus.webapp-component.stop
claims.claim: src/hermes_webapp_component.py refuses to stop the managed gateway from a command that runs inside that gateway (a turn would be lost with an unknown outcome), and refuses while turns are running unless forced.

evidence.contains: This command is running inside the gateway it would stop

claims.subject: odysseus.hermes-backend.switch
claims.claim: src/application_modes.py selects the Hermes integration from ODYSSEUS_HERMES_BACKEND: the value gateway uses the official gateway, the value webapp uses the managed Webapp component, and an unset value keeps the older component behaviour.

claims.subject: odysseus.wiki-mcp.lifecycle
claims.claim: scripts/wiki_mcp.py runs only for the length of an agent session, started by that agent's own MCP client, with nothing running in the background; the agent identity comes from the WIKI_AGENT environment variable.

evidence.contains: for the length of its session; nothing runs in the background.

claims.subject: odysseus.mcp.reload
claims.claim: integrations/hermes-mode/patches/webapp-mcp-recovery.patch adds a Reload MCP servers button to the Desktop Connectors tab that asks for confirmation before it asks the gateway to run reload.mcp, which refreshes every chat of the profile.

evidence.contains: Consent gate for the manual reload

claims.subject: odysseus.workspace.write-roots
claims.claim: src/hermes_webapp_component.py starts the managed gateway with HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT set to an empty folder owned by the component, so nothing is writable by default; folders the user granted are read live from the component config by the odysseus-workspace-grants plugin, and without that plugin the grants do not apply.

claims.subject: odysseus.route-guard.git-publish
claims.claim: integrations/hermes-mode/patches/webapp-route-guard.patch disables git push and pull-request creation from the Webapp's direct routes unless the operator sets HERMES_WEBAPP_ALLOW_GIT_PUBLISH=1.

evidence.contains: Publishing (push / pull request) from the web interface is disabled.

claims.subject: odysseus.grants.gate
claims.claim: src/hermes_grants.py keeps server-side access grants bound to an Odysseus browser session as an additional gate in front of the Hermes origin; the gateway's own authentication still decides every request and the grants do not protect against a copied gateway credential.

claims.subject: odysseus.ask-policy.limits
claims.claim: docs/hermes-ask-policy.md states that the odysseus-ask-policy plugin asks before tools that are not on a read-only list but does not sandbox: an approved command runs with the user's full Windows rights.

evidence.contains: It asks. It does not sandbox.
